changelog:
agent-stress-index 1.0.0

- Initial release of a composite stress index for measuring systemic risk across all APEX modules.
- Delivers real-time, proprietary intelligence sourced from live trading on major crypto exchanges.
- Access via x402-authenticated GET request with EVM wallet–based authorization; no subscription needed.
- Tiered, usage-based pricing with automatic early adopter discounts.
- Includes example API response and code integration instructions.
- Linked to related systemic risk and trading signals for comprehensive monitoring.
summary: Composite stress index measuring systemic risk across all APEX modules
